name: team-room
description: A team's everyday room: announcements, requests and decisions, engineering work and on-call, and a place to chat.
welcome: Welcome to the team room. Read #announcements first, ask in #help, and take decisions to #decisions so they are easy to find later.

sections.name: Product
sections.rules: Bring the background and the goal. Decided items go to #decisions.

sections.name: Engineering
sections.rules: Post a minimal reproduction with a code question. Production issues go to #on-call first.

channels.name: announcements
channels.rules: Notices only; discuss them in the channel they belong to.

channels.name: help
channels.purpose: Questions that fit nowhere else; someone will point you on

channels.name: requests
channels.purpose: New requests and feedback, one thread each

channels.name: decisions
channels.purpose: Decisions that were made, one a post
channels.rules: One decision a post: the decision, why, the date and who owns it.

channels.name: dev
channels.purpose: Work in progress and code discussion

channels.name: on-call
channels.rules: Each alert: service, symptom, impact, who is on it.
